claims.claim_text: Z.ai 的 GLM-5.2 登上 Artificial Analysis 的開放權重智慧指數第一名，成為這份榜上目前最強的開放權重模型。
claims.evidence: "GLM-5.2 is the new leading open weights model on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index"; "GLM-5.2 is the leading open weights model on the Intelligence Index v4.1." Unqualified source language; lede 第一名/最強 matches.

claims.claim_text: Epic Games 開源了 Lore，一套把規模化當成第一設計目標的版本控制系統，定位是遊戲級超大 codebase 與 monorepo 的 Git/Perforce 替代。
claims.evidence: "Maintained by Epic Games, Lore is designed for unprecedented scalability of both data and teams."; "Lore is fully open source and released under an MIT license."; "optimized for projects—including games and entertainment—that combine code with large binary assets." Git/Perforce framing is the post's reasonable characterization; central claim supported.

claims.claim_text: 一位資安研究者寫下他怎麼差點能 rickroll 整場 FIFA 世界盃：靠著手上一張身分憑證，他摸到一個能往大型轉播或顯示注入內容的存取破口；有效身分不等於有權限做任何事。
claims.evidence: "An attacker could have rickrolled the entire FIFA World Cup."; "The whole thing boils down to one architectural mistake: client-side authorization with no server-side enforcement." Lede hedged framing matches; source notes "I did not test this."

claims.claim_text: browser-use 拆解了他們怎麼在 EC2 裡跑 AWS Firecracker microVM，把無頭瀏覽器的冷啟壓進一秒內。關鍵是 microVM 的 snapshot/restore。
claims.evidence: "browser create latency is 825ms at p50 and 1.35s at p99."; "The VM cold start is under 400ms." Source headlines under-a-second; p50 825ms supports 一秒內 for the typical case (p99 1.35s noted).

claims.claim_text: Firefox 把壓縮庫換成純 Rust 重寫的 zlib-rs，用記憶體安全的實作取代沿用多年的 C 版 zlib，而吞吐量維持相當、甚至更好。
claims.evidence: "As of 151.0.0, Firefox uses zlib-rs for gzip (de)compression." Large speedups shown; aarch64/macOS smaller — lede 維持相當、甚至更好 accommodates the variance.

claims.claim_text: OpenBSD 的 PPP 堆疊裡被挖出一個躺了 27 年的認證繞過：PAP 認證的狀態機處理有誤，讓人能跳過憑證檢查。作者附上根因分析與 PoC，並說明修法。
claims.evidence: "The vulnerability was introduced in 1999 and survived for 27 years before being fixed."; "Sending zero-length name and password fields caused bcmp to return 0 unconditionally, bypassing PAP authentication entirely." PoC + fix (CVE-2026-55706) confirmed.

claims.claim_text: 一篇文章認真追問 gzip 這種壓縮器能不能當語言模型；壓得越好等於對下一段內容預測得越準，作者實際拿 gzip 跑文字生成來驗證這個關係。
claims.evidence: "every prediction model is inherently a compressor, and all compression algorithms are prediction models."; "give it a normal text prompt, and it continues that prompt by searching for the byte sequences that compress best." Experiment + premise supported.

claims.claim_text: 一篇給凡人的 Oklch 實戰指南；Oklch 的亮度軸是感知均勻的，所以用程式去調色比 sRGB 或 HSL 可預測得多。
claims.evidence: "Perceptual is key here... the subsequent colors you chose will all look perceptually 60% bright... regardless of what color you pick."; "we can move any one of the L,C,H components while the other two actually hold steady."

claims.claim_text: Docker 宣布讓 Docker Content Trust（DCT）與 Notary v1 退役，並提供遷移指引。
claims.evidence: "Docker Content Trust (DCT) and the Notary v1 service at notary.docker.io are being fully retired (first announced in July of 2025)." Migration alternatives (Sigstore/Cosign, Notation) provided.

claims.claim_text: Adobe 與微軟合作，用 MSVC 工具鏈的 Sample-based Profile-Guided Optimization（SPGO）替 Windows 版 Photoshop 做最佳化，量到可觀的 CPU 效能提升；用取樣式 profile 取代傳統 instrumented PGO。
claims.evidence: "combining MSVC's peak-performance build settings with Sample-based Profile-Guided Optimization (SPGO)."; "improvements of 20% on x64 and 13% on ARM64."; "SPGO uses profile data gathered from standard release binaries... Rather than depending on a separate instrumented build."
